title: Formation directe d'une interface eau-roche-gaz à partir de la croûte primitive et de l'hydrosphère
rationale: Cette voie conserve H052 intact. Elle teste si N030 peut être obtenu en amont par interaction directe entre une croûte primitive analogue et un réservoir H2O/CO2, ce qui casse ensuite le cycle canonique N029-N030-N053-N054.

primary_sources.citation: Hao & Li 2018, Frontiers in Earth Science 6:180
primary_sources.supports: Controlled reactions of komatiite, peridotite and basalt with H2O-CO2 at 200-500 C explicitly simulate earliest-Earth crust/proto-atmosphere interaction and produce secondary phyllosilicates/carbonates and gases.

primary_sources.citation: Ueda et al. 2021, Geochemistry Geophysics Geosystems 22:e2021GC009827
primary_sources.supports: Controlled synthetic-komatiite/CO2-rich early-seawater experiments measure time-resolved dissolved species, pH and H2; the study identifies mixing zones between alkaline H2-rich hydrothermal fluid and acidic/neutral Hadean seawater as electrochemical-potential-bearing interfaces.

Primary experiments show transition-metal-adsorbed carbonate and phyllosilicate minerals catalyze abiotic CO2 reduction; the paper explicitly connects these minerals to ultramafic/mafic alteration in primitive seawater and also tests H2-driven hydrothermal geoelectrochemical conditions.

promotion_rule: The frozen v0.9.3 hypergraph is not rewritten. HC02 is admitted as an evidence-qualified extension only because every N030 semantic component is traceable to primary controlled experiments; the extension must remain separately auditable and removable.
scope_limit: 53/53 in the HC02 extension is strict structural reachability. It does not establish a unique natural history, validate H033, or change Section XIV.
